name: B-spline Wavelet Basis Construction
definition: Use of Chui and Wang B-spline wavelet bases of order j for volume data compression and rendering, providing smoothness, vanishing moments, and analytic expressions in frequency and spatial domains.
summary: B-spline Wavelet Basis Construction generates semi-orthogonal Chui and Wang wavelets with analytic spatial and frequency representations, enabling efficient volume rendering splatting while maintaining B-spline smoothness.
